<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the compound shows a carbonyl carbon at ~166 ppm, aromatic carbons between 116–151 ppm, an O‑CH₂ signal at ~61 ppm and a methyl at ~14 ppm. This pattern matches an ethyl ester of benzoic acid (ethyl benzoate). Its SMILES representation is “CCOC(=O)c1ccccc1”.</thought>
<final_answer>CCOC(=O)c1ccccc1</final_answer>
